subtitle: A teacher's reason to look for support
note: Illustrative context grounded in teacher preparation workload and fragmented tools. This is not a measured customer journey.
steps: I have useful material, but finding the right piece takes time.
Searches existing files for one suitable resource.
I keep making similar changes for different learners.
Identifies one preparation task he repeats.
Could this help me teach in my own way?
Explores Mimo as a possible teaching tool.

subtitle: Current prototype / shared entry and teacher branch
note: The shared greeting uses Luma before the role is chosen. Choosing teacher switches to Nori. Email and code verification are local simulations.
steps: Let me see how this works.
The next steps will help learners get to know me.
I want a simple way to sign in.
Enters an email address in the preview.
I can try the code without waiting for an email.

Teacher introduction
“Your language. Your way of teaching.”
My way of teaching belongs here.

subtitle: Current prototype / one profile choice or entry per step
note: Photo/video is optional and stays local (up to 20 MB). Language and level selections allow multiple choices. The approach field is limited to 300 characters.
steps: This is how learners will address me.
Enters the name learners should use.

Local photo/video picker
“Skip for now” alternative
I want to give a friendly first impression.
Adds a profile image or short video if desired.
I can choose the languages I actually teach.
Selects one or more teaching languages.
I should choose levels I can support well.
Selects the proficiency levels he teaches.
I can explain what a lesson with me feels like.
Writes a short description of his approach.

subtitle: Current prototype / format, location, duration and price
note: Format and city can be deferred. Online skips the city screen. The review remains a draft; the price does not trigger payment.
steps:
In person / Online / Either
“I’ll choose later”
I can choose a format that works for me.

City or neighbourhood field
“I’ll choose later”
A city is enough; I do not need to share my address.
Enters a city or neighbourhood if relevant.
This is enough time for a focused lesson.
I want the price to reflect my time.
Enters a price for the chosen duration.
Does this represent how I want to teach?

subtitle: Current prototype / document route with sample details only
note: At step 21, choose document preview, Persona shortcut, or finish later. The seven cards here show the document route. No real identity check is submitted.
steps: I need to know what this check does.
This is separate from my display name.
Enters an example full legal name.
My birth date should stay private.
Enters an example date of birth.
Which country issued this sample ID?
I can see which document types are offered.
I can try this without uploading my real ID.

“Try the sample check”
No camera access
I do not have to turn on my camera for this preview.

subtitle: Current prototype / exit routes, not four consecutive steps
note: Document route: 27 → 28. Persona: 21 → A1 → 28. Fallback: A1 → A2 → 22. Defer: 21 → A3. Both end screens offer Replay onboarding; neither opens a live teacher workspace.
steps: I have finished the preview, not a real verification.

Link Persona ID
“Link sample Persona ID”
I can try the shorter route.
Links the built-in sample Persona identity.
I can return to the document route.
Switches from Persona to the legal-name screen.
I can stop here and finish later.

subtitle: Proposed experience / after future account readiness and booking
note: The prototype ends at onboarding. These steps assume future account readiness and an agreed booking; they do not imply current integrations or a live workspace.
steps: I want lessons to fit the time I can offer.

Confirmed session
Time and meeting format
I know when and where this lesson will happen.

Learner goal brief
Relevant shared example
What should this learner be able to do?
I already have a useful starting point.
I can make this right for this learner.
Adapts the lesson to the learner's needs.

Learner-view preview
Optional AI draft review
Nothing should be shared before I am happy with it.

Explicit share action
Private learner space
The learner can now see the version I chose.

subtitle: Proposed experience / one teacher and one learner
note: The journey supports an online call or an in-person meeting. The teacher remains responsible for pacing, correction and adaptation.
steps: I know how to meet the learner.
I want them to feel comfortable speaking.
We know what we are working towards.
The activity should lead to useful conversation.
One clear correction can help more than many at once.
Gives feedback on one observed difficulty.
I want to remember what mattered today.

subtitle: Proposed experience / useful continuity without extra pressure
note: AI assistance, if used, remains optional and reviewable. Practice is optional. Feedback is private. Reduced workload and improved learning are hypotheses to test.
steps: What is worth remembering from this lesson?
The recap needs to reflect what really happened.

Private learner conversation
Explicit share action
The learner can revisit the important points.
This could help when they have time.
Suggests one relevant optional practice activity.
I know what to build on next time.
Chooses a focus for a possible next lesson.
